২০২৩ সালে Butlin ও সহলেখকদের একটি আন্তবি: In 2023, an interdisciplinary report by Butlin and colleagues proposed deriving potential indicator properties from neuroscientific theories of consciousness and applying them to AI. Their assessment did not find sufficient grounds for attributing consciousness to the AI systems examined at the time, while also not ruling out future systems. This is a research-based assessment, not definitive proof. [4]

AI-র বিষয়গত অভিজ্ঞতা যাচাই করার কোনো সর্: There is no universally accepted test for AI’s subjective experience. An AI saying “I am happy” in conversation or responding in human-like ways is therefore not sufficient evidence of consciousness. These observations also do not justify a definitive rejection of every possible future AI system.
